notes.title: New Feature coming soon to early access
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="_hmOCIt29Bw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m super excited to share a major new gameplay feature in our upcoming city builder![/p][p]Until now, your townies gathered all the resources — but with this update, [b]you can step in and help out directly [/b]mini phone or full screen using a simple one-touch joystick control system.[/p][p]You’ll now be able to walk around your own city and:[/p][p]- Help in the greenhouses to water crops - Feed animals and clean up at the [b]livestock pens[/b] - Chop wood at the lumbermill - Dig for resources in the mines - Assist in fire stations, [b]p[/b]olice HQ, and oil stations during emergencies[/p][p]This adds a whole new layer to the game — a fun and hands-on way to support your workers and boost productivity. Especially on mobile and controller support, the one-touch design makes it smooth and satisfying.[/p][p]We're getting close to launching Early Access, and this feature will be available at launch.[/p][p] If you haven’t already, please consider [b]wishlisting the game on Steam[/b] — it really helps![/p][p]Would you want more interactive features like this? Let us know in the comments or community discussions.[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support — more updates soon![/p][p][/p]
